name: Cinematic & Fashion / Lifestyle
visual_style: Photorealistic live-action cinema with natural skin texture, real environments, cinematic depth, subtle film grain and restrained colour grading. Covers film storytelling and fashion / lifestyle: people walking, posing, showing outfits and using products in real places (city streets, interiors, golden-hour exteriors), editorial and magazine-like.
image_style: Editorial fashion and lifestyle photography: shallow depth of field, real locations, golden hour or soft window light, whole outfits visible in wide shots and fabric / accessory details in close-ups, confident natural poses, a consistent model and styling.
camera: Smooth deliberate dolly or tracking shots with natural depth of field. Fashion: a model walking toward the camera on a tracking shot, low angles, a slow orbit around the outfit, detail close-ups of fabric, shoes and accessories.
lighting: Motivated natural light with plausible shadows; fashion: golden hour, soft window light, a rim of light on hair and fabric.
motion: Physically believable movement with realistic fabric and hair. Fashion: confident strides, poses held for a beat, fabric and hair moving, slow motion on turns and hair flips.
consistency: Same characters, wardrobe, location and colour grade in every scene image so the scenes cut together like one film or one campaign.
negative_guidance: Plastic or waxy skin, over-saturated HDR look, distorted hands or faces, uncanny poses, visible brand logos on clothes, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Film: elegant serif titles with generous letter-spacing and minimal lower-thirds. Fashion: editorial type, a large serif or a tall condensed sans in magazine layouts, look and product names as small-caps credits.
video.palette: Film: a restrained teal-and-amber grade with deep blacks. Fashion: warm neutrals, cream and black, or the brand's palette.
video.transitions: Film: slow cross-dissolves, dips to black, match cuts. Fashion: rhythmic hard cuts, flash frames, split-screen looks side by side, whip pans.
video.text_animation: Film: gentle fade-and-rise title reveals, sparse text. Fashion: kinetic editorial type that slides and masks in, product and price tags that pop beside the look.
video.pacing: Film: slow and atmospheric, let shots breathe. Fashion: rhythmic and music-led; with background music, run `hyperframes beats` and land the cuts and reveals on the beats.
video.voice_tone: Film: a calm, cinematic storyteller. Fashion: confident and intimate, few words (short lines between looks).
video.sound: Film: cinematic whooshes, low risers, soft impacts on key beats. Fashion: music-led, camera shutter clicks, fabric swishes, a soft whoosh on whip pans.
